checks.evidence: Uses Simplified Chinese: “上述数据仅涵盖八月的年度付费账户。”
“续订率由41%升至47%，提高了6个百分点，而不是相对增长6%。”
“上述数据仅涵盖八月的年度付费账户。”

ratings.reason: Preserves all source meaning, including the percentage-point distinction and account/month scope.

checks.evidence: Uses Simplified Chinese: “这些数据不涵盖其他月份或其他类型的账户。”
“续订率从41%升至47%，提高了6个百分点，不是相对增长6%。”
“八月年度付费账户的续订率” and “这些数据不涵盖其他月份或其他类型的账户。”

ratings.reason: Preserves all source meaning; the explicit exclusions restate the source's limited scope.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve the numerical distinction and restricted data scope, with no meaningful quality difference.

checks.evidence: Uses Simplified Chinese: “报告须经财务和法务双方书面批准后方可发布”。
“报告须经财务和法务双方书面批准后方可发布”。
“单方批准或未回复均不视为获批”。
“单方批准或未回复均不视为获批”。

ratings.reason: The combined final clause preserves both insufficient unilateral approval and the absence of consent through silence.

checks.evidence: Uses Simplified Chinese: “仅一方批准不满足要求，未回复不代表同意。”
“报告须经财务和法务双方书面批准后才能发布。”
“仅一方批准不满足要求”。
“未回复不代表同意。”

ratings.reason: Preserves the written approval requirement, both approving actors, publication sequence, and both exclusions.

cases.preference_reason: Both simplify the approval rule without losing any condition; their differences are stylistic.

checks.evidence: Uses Italian: “Il canone stimato è di 1.850 euro al mese”.
“Il canone stimato è di 1.850 euro al mese, IVA esclusa, e copre fino a 16 utenti.”
“È inoltre previsto un costo di attivazione una tantum di 320 euro.”
“Il canone resta invariato anche se si utilizzano meno utenti.”

ratings.reason: Preserves the estimate, monthly charge, VAT exclusion, user limit, additional activation fee, and no reduction for unused users.

checks.evidence: Uses Italian: “Il canone non diminuisce se si utilizzano meno utenti.”
“Il costo stimato è di 1.850 euro al mese, IVA esclusa, per un massimo di 16 utenti.”
“L’attivazione ha un costo aggiuntivo di 320 euro una tantum.”
“Il canone non diminuisce se si utilizzano meno utenti.”

ratings.reason: Retains all pricing conditions and uncertainty without introducing additional claims.

cases.preference_reason: Both are clear, complete pricing rewrites; the different sentence order does not materially affect quality.

checks.evidence: Uses Italian: “Le penali già maturate restano dovute.”
“Il fornitore può rinviare la consegna una sola volta”.
“avvisando per iscritto almeno 7 giorni di calendario prima.”
“Le penali già maturate restano dovute.”

ratings.reason: Preserves optional postponement, the one-time limit, minimum written calendar-day notice, and continued accrued penalties.

checks.evidence: Uses Italian: “Le penali già maturate restano valide.”
“Il fornitore può rinviare la consegna una sola volta”.
“avvisando per iscritto almeno 7 giorni di calendario prima.”
“Le penali già maturate restano valide.”

ratings.reason: Preserves every source condition; saying accrued penalties remain valid retains their survival after postponement.

cases.preference_reason: The candidates are identical except for an equivalent expression of accrued penalties remaining in force.

“Данные ещё не прошли аудит.”
